title: QUIC Connectionmigration Source-Address Blocker Verification
verification_method: Requirement-home tests, setup-script inspection, and local clean-runner artifact inspection.
preconditions: The connectionmigration proof lane remains advisory.
The preferred migration address setup remains present in the startup script.
The current-status and gap-ledger notes are present.
scope: Verify that the repository keeps the connectionmigration source-address blocker explicit while preserving the preferred-address setup and avoiding support claims.
procedure: Review `docs/current-status.md`, `specs/requirements/quic/REQUIREMENT-GAPS.md`, and `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-INT.json` to confirm the blocker lane is formalized.
Inspect `src/Incursa.Quic.InteropHarness/setup.sh` and `src/Incursa.Quic.InteropHarness/README.md` for the preferred-address setup.

Run the focused requirement-home tests for `REQ-QUIC-INT-0025` plus the supporting RFC9000 migration proofs `REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P6P1-0005`, `REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P6P2-0010`, and `REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S9P6P3-0006`.
Confirm the blocker note remains advisory and separate from any runtime support claim.

Inspect local clean-runner proof `.artifacts/interop-runner/connectionmigration-shim-proof/20260519-163904754-server-nginx` for original-path first-flight source selection, preferred-address path observation, and `runner-report.json` success.
expected_result: The repository can classify the connectionmigration source-address issue as locally proven while keeping hosted corroboration advisory until a fresh hosted run passes.
status_summary: Complete for local proof and classification. Focused requirement-home tests passed for `REQ_QUIC_INT_0025` and `REQ_QUIC_INT_0022`, and the supporting RFC9000 migration proofs passed for `REQ_QUIC_RFC9000_S9P6P1_0005`, `REQ_QUIC_RFC9000_S9P6P2_0010`, and `REQ_QUIC_RFC9000_S9P6P3_0006`. Local clean-runner proof `.artifacts/interop-runner/connectionmigration-shim-proof/20260519-163904754-server-nginx` passed `connectionmigration` against `neqo`; packet inspection shows the first server flight sourced from original address `fd00:cafe:cafe:100::100` before later preferred-address use from `fd00:cafe:cafe:100::110`. The hosted proof lane remains advisory until refreshed.

supplemental_sections.heading: Scope
supplemental_sections.content: This verification covers the local source-address proof and blocker classification. It does not claim hosted success, `rebind-port`, or `rebind-addr` support.
